whenToUse: Large headings of two or three lines.
The first screen of an introduction page.
Copy where the rhythm of the sentence matters.
whenNotToUse: Long paragraphs (the last word appears too late).
Headings on screens people see often.
Korean split letter by letter (final consonants and shapes look awkward).

alternatives.name: Mask Reveal
alternatives.reason: Lines rising from behind a mask.

alternatives.name: Stagger
alternatives.reason: Showing cards or list items in turn.

accessibility: Screen readers get the whole sentence at once via sr-only text.
The split lines and words are aria-hidden so they aren't read in pieces.
With reduced motion, everything shows at once.
The unit choice is a set of radio buttons, changeable with the keyboard.
